scope: Additive Grand Warden Heroic Torch L1-27 active aura, balance and Wall interaction audit; temporary Splash Bash content excluded.
game_version: Official August and October 2025 and January and April 2026 updates; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Make a Splash This Clashiversary!
facts: Grand Warden Epic Equipment lets nearby Troops move through Walls, move faster and take less damage.
sources.limitations: No aura radius, eligible class list, speed/reduction scalar, Wall entry/exit path rule or duration table; event troops and Piñatas are temporary and excluded.

sources.title: Get Ready for Ranked! - Update
facts: Heroic Torch speed boost now applies to Grand Warden.
An issue with units stuck inside Walls when Heroic Torch ends was fixed.
sources.limitations: No current speed unit, overlap rule or expiry relocation algorithm is given.

sources.title: January Balance Changes!
facts: Equipment HP bonus increased by 9-17%, DPS bonus by 9-20%, HP regained on activation by 4-10%, duration by 36-45% and damage reduction by 50-250% across levels.
sources.limitations: Only percentage ranges, not replacement values or per-level mapping, are published. Which HP field corresponds to the pinned opaque damageReductionIncrease field is not established.

sources.title: THE SOUND OF CLASH UPDATE
facts: Totems are immune to the Heroic Torch ability.
sources.limitations: Does not enumerate other eligible or excluded spawned units, Pets or Heroes.

sources.title: Heroic Torch — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table displays Warden DPS 12-78, a field labeled hitpoints 35-137, upgrade costs and level cap 27.
sources.limitations: The source does not expose the raw field mapping or current aura duration, speed and reduction. The 35-137 column cannot independently resolve the raw damageReductionIncrease naming ambiguity.

sources.title: Pinned Heroic Torch Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned duration is 16-27.5 seconds, speedIncrease 5-9, incomingDamageReduction 6-15%, dpsIncrease 12-78, hpRecoveryIncrease 110-390 and damageReductionIncrease 35-137.
sources.limitations: The 2026 official rebalance supersedes multiple pinned numeric series; raw field semantics and activation/tick order are not documented.

derivations.result: Keep pinned series as historical catalogue provenance, not executable current modifiers
derivations.method: Compare every pinned level with the January 2026 official percentage-range rebalance; do not manufacture per-level replacement numbers.

derivations.result: Nearby Troops receive Wall pass-through, speed and damage reduction; Warden receives speed; Totems are excluded
derivations.method: Combine August 2025 launch, October 2025 Warden speed fix and April 2026 Totem exclusion; leave all other eligibility and tick order unresolved.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply pinned 16-27.5-second durations or 6-15% reductions as current
rejected_inferences.reason: Official January 2026 increased duration and damage reduction without publishing replacement level values.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the full Torch aura to the Warden because speed now affects him
rejected_inferences.reason: Official October 2025 note confirms only Warden speed inclusion, not Wall traversal or damage reduction.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the dated 35-137 hitpoint display as exact HP bonus semantics
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned field is named damageReductionIncrease and the mapping is opaque; the official HP increase range does not resolve it.

rejected_inferences.rule: Move an aura-expiry unit to a nearest free tile
rejected_inferences.reason: The Wall-stuck bug fix does not publish an exit/relocation algorithm.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Torch to Totems or temporary Splash Bash units
rejected_inferences.reason: April 2026 explicitly excludes Totems and the event units are out of scope.

items: current per-level HP, DPS, HP regain, duration and reduction values after January 2026
speed unit, radius, boundary, eligible Troops, Pets, Heroes and spawned children
Wall crossing entry/exit, path clearance and expiry collision resolution
damage reduction stage, rounding, traps, auras, spells and Totem exclusion order
activation, auto-activation, Warden ground/air mode, death and other Equipment order
Viewer aura/Wall visuals, compatible art rights, snapshot, replay and RL activation state

conclusion: Heroic Torch L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official notes establish nearby Troop Wall traversal, speed and damage reduction, Warden speed inclusion, Totem exclusion and major January 2026 numeric buffs, but current per-level modifiers and deterministic aura/Wall timing are unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
